info.name: SolarKits - ICICI E-Collection APIs
info.description: Collection for testing ICICI Bank E-Collection Webhooks, Virtual Accounts, and Reconciliation in SolarKits Backend.

query.description: EPC Buyer ya Franchisee ka 10-digit mobile number

request.description: Checkout page par buyer ke liye dedicated Virtual Account Number aur IFSC return karta hai.

body.raw:
{
  "ClientCode": "SLRK",
  "VirtualAccountNumber": "SLRK9876543210",
  "Mode": "RTGS",
  "UTR": "ICIC{{$timestamp}}",
  "SenderRemark": "Solar BOS Kit Advance",
  "ClientAccountNo": "TEL9876543210",
  "Amount": "1500000.00",
  "PayerName": "Apex Solar Energy EPC Pvt Ltd",
  "PayerAccNumber": "000123456789",
  "PayerBankIFSC": "HDFC0001234",
  "PayerPaymentDate": "20260930",
  "BankInternalTransactionNumber": "REQ{{$timestamp}}",
  "USERID": "ICICI_GATEWAY"
}

request.description: Franchise partner ke purchase order (PO) ki automated payment reconciliation test karne ke liye.
Isko do baar send karke test karein. Dusri baar me Code 06 (Duplicate UTR) response aayega.
Database me save hue saare ICICI transactions aur audit logs fetch karta hai.
